title: Bobby's spherical flow conjecture for bridgeless cubic graphs
statement: Let $G$ be a bridgeless cubic graph. An **$\mathbb{S}^2$-flow** is a unit vector flow with values on the unit sphere $\mathbb{S}^2$. **Bobby's spherical flow conjecture.** Every bridgeless cubic graph has an $\mathbb{S}^2$-flow. This conjecture is proposed as one of two conjectures intended to imply Tutte's $5$-flow conjecture; its status is not resolved in the supplied text.
source_name: Hussein Houdrouge, Bobby Miraftab and Pat Morin, “2-dimensional unit vector flows”, arXiv:2602.21526 (2026).
references:
